_MONTH_CUM = (0, 0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334)

    return type(x) is int


def _is_date(d):
    return type(d) is tuple and len(d) == 3 and all(type(x) is int for x in d)

        raise ValueError("year out of range")
    if not (1 <= m <= 12):
        raise ValueError("month out of range")
    if not (1 <= d <= days_in_month(y, m)):

    return r

        raise TypeError("year must be int")
    if not (1 <= y <= 9999):
        raise ValueError("year out of range")
    return y % 4 == 0 and (y % 100 != 0 or y % 400 == 0)

        raise TypeError("year and month must be int")

    if not (1 <= m <= 12):

    return _days_before_year(y) + _days_before_month(y, m) + d
